name: dead-claude-skills
description: Interactive installer for the dead-claude-skills Claude Code marketplace.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-repo.mjs && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="installer/**" --test-coverage-exclude="installer/**/*.test.ts" --test-coverage-lines=79 "installer/**/*.test.ts" && node --test "scripts/*.test.mjs" "plugins/flows/skills/writing/tests/*.test.mjs" "plugins/default/hooks/*.test.mjs" "plugins/flows/hooks/*.test.mjs" "plugins/opt-in/headroom-trim/hooks/*.test.mjs" "plugins/opt-in/flow-cockpit/hooks/*.test.mjs" && npm test --workspace=@dead-claude-skills/upstream-sync
scripts.scan-skills: pipx run --spec cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.3.2 skill-scanner scan-all plugins --recursive --policy .github/skill-scanner.yaml --fail-on-severity high
